# Evaluate External Project

Review the candidate's capabilities, language/framework, architecture, dependency footprint, license and attribution, maintenance/release history, security posture, and compatibility with BOOKzMA. Compare four options: borrow the idea, reimplement in our architecture, use an API/SDK or isolated service, or transfer code directly. Explain tradeoffs and recommend the smallest suitable option. Do not run or copy candidate code; flag unknowns and licensing questions for owner review. Record a decision proposal in `docs/DECISIONS.md` and a candidate in `docs/ROADMAP.md` only after owner approval.
